local_context.value: Barrier island and census-designated place in Beaufort County; elevation 0 ft; about three miles of Atlantic beachfront, some parts fully submerged at high tide; wide marsh and estuarine system separates it from St. Helena Island; most seaward of the Sea Islands. Residential vacation resort of homes and condominiums, a private gated community run by the Fripp Island Property Owners Association; nearly one-third of lots undeveloped. Population 963 (2020), up to about 5,000 in summer. Page gives no hurricane/climate text.

Mostly villa/condominium regimes; no single-family neighbourhood names published (one gated island, one POA). Text re-read cleanly 2026-10-12.

things_to_do.value: Ocean Point Golf Links, Ocean Creek Golf Course (Davis Love III design), racquet club, marina, island-wide Audubon bird preserve and loggerhead turtle hatchery. The page calls it a private gated community; public access to these is not stated.

top_sites.value: Fripp Inlet Bridge (opened 1964, now toll-free); island-wide Audubon bird preserve; loggerhead turtle hatchery; all-faiths chapel.
